entities.name: Jace Beleren
entities.description: A mind mage and planeswalker who wakes on an island with no memory of who he is, and rediscovers his gift for illusions.

entities.name: Vraska
entities.description: A gorgon who captains the ship the Belligerent and knows Jace; this page does not name her.

entities.name: Useless Island
entities.description: The jungle island where Jace wakes without his memory, named by him in frustration.

entities.name: The Belligerent
entities.description: A tall ship with brilliantly colored sails, captained by the gorgon who finds Jace.

entities.name: Malcolm
entities.description: A member of the Belligerent's crew.

events.summary: Jace wakes in a bamboo grove on an island with no memory of how he arrived or of his own name.
events.quote: He did not know how he had gotten here. He did not know his own name.

events.summary: Jace instinctively tries to planeswalk away, but a massive force yanks him back and a circle-and-triangle sigil appears above him.
events.quote: only to feel himself yanked backward, pulled by some massive force back through whatever metaphysical door he had begun to walk through

events.summary: Jace finds deliberate, surgical scars on his right forearm and back.
events.quote: A scar ran in a perfect line down his right forearm.

events.summary: A fire Jace wills into being gives no heat and vanishes in blue light; he concludes he has gone insane.
events.quote: The man solemnly concluded that he had gone insane.

events.summary: Jace sees visions of people from his forgotten past, among them a woman in violet who makes him anxious.
events.quote: he would sometimes see a woman in violet on the edge of his field of vision

events.summary: Jace realizes his visions are illusions he casts himself and that he is a mage.
events.quote: I'm not hallucinating—I've been creating illusions!

events.summary: An illusion of a raven-haired woman in violet tells Jace he was never a leader or a detective, only a frightened child playing pretend.
events.quote: you were a frightened child playing pretend

events.summary: Jace takes control of his magic, ending his involuntary illusions, and resolves to become whoever he wants to be.
events.quote: Whoever I was is irrelevant, for I will become whoever I want to become.

events.summary: Jace builds a raft and sails away from Useless Island.
events.quote: Useless Island disappeared over the horizon, and infinite azure stretched out in front of him.

events.summary: A storm wrecks Jace's raft and he washes up on a barren rock covered in seabirds.
events.quote: Exhausted and defeated, the man kicked himself over toward his new home.

events.summary: Descending into his own mind, Jace finds his spark, the one part of himself his memory loss did not take.
events.quote: a shining light embedded in the well of his mind

events.summary: Jace tries to planeswalk again and is pulled back once more by the same sigil.
events.quote: Once again, he felt himself violently tugged backward

events.summary: The ship the Belligerent finds Jace; its gorgon captain, Vraska, threatens him, then sees the state he is in and recognizes him by name.
events.quote: Jace, what the hell happened to you?

relations.note: At first she threatens to kill him unless he says who he works for.
relations.quote: Tell me who you're working for and your death will be a painless one!
a regal woman he could only assume was the captain of the ship
